metadata.carryless_scope: coeffclmul/coeffnibble encode directly to binary planes using 512 KiB byte or 64 KiB nibble tables; four-row VPCLMUL Karatsuba high convolution, AES reduction, decode and original register consumer; same 2048-row outer blocks as PairAggregate; all witness conversions online; safe original native/lookup fallback; corresponding reuse modes retain independent scratch capacity
metadata.coefficient_scope: coefflookup/coeffnative use monomial row encoding and upper schoolbook products; coeffnative uses GFNI/AVX-512 when available; column claims and monomial quotient bytes are identical to existing kernels; interpolate_quotient_ms measures sparse division for these modes; witness-to-coefficient conversion and products are online and timed; only input-independent lookup tables persist; coefflookupreuse/coeffnativereuse retain independent per-system allocation capacity
metadata.kernel_scope: reference/lookup/native/tiled/basis/register/split/half/pair/affine/joint select the first aggregation only; native/reuse preserve the v5 kernel; basis/basisreuse retain v6 batched coordinate conversion; register/registerreuse avoid its intermediate zeroing; registerpacked/registerpackedreuse also defer IP message horizontal folds within each packing task; split/splitreuse separate H and continuation accumulation in eight-coordinate loops; half/halfreuse group eight coordinates by sample half; pair/pairreuse unroll paired continuation interpolation with the original consume loop; affine/affinereuse replace split H masks with eight-row GFNI affine maps; joint/jointreuse combine paired interpolation and affine H; split/half/pair/affine/joint retain the v6 Batch conversion and original packing; every mode uses the same mathematical GF256 basis, C projection, weights and IP protocol with hardware fallbacks
metadata.memory: VmHWM read immediately after prove, before verify and source checks; includes input and runtime

metadata.scratch: reuse/tiledreuse/basisreuse/registerreuse/registerpackedreuse/splitreuse/halfreuse/pairreuse/affinereuse/jointreuse retain independent per-system allocation capacity, reset for each dimension; other Mikros modes allocate and deallocate per proof; all dynamic values rebuilt; Flock uses its production pool

metadata.source_check_policy: Every proof is verified and its transcript checked; each (dimension,run) has new immutable inputs and a new cache. First Mikros claims use the full source oracle; optional --reuse-source-checks permits later kernels only when their verifier-returned Claims equal the previously checked Claims exactly. Records identify full_oracle versus exact_claim_cache and the anchor system. Flock always uses its full oracle. All checks and comparisons are outside prover timing.
metadata.timing: input generation/digest, challenger creation, serialization and source claim checks excluded; verifier is reduction replay only
